title: antirrhinum majus var. ochroleucum
intro: Antirrhinum majus var. ochroleucum, commonly known as the Yellow Snap Dragon or Yellow Trumpet Flower, is a variety of the Antirrhinum majus plant, which is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum majus var. ochroleucum include its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular natural remedy for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
